module Greeter

export greet

struct Point{T<:Real}
    x::T
    y::T
end

function greet(name::String, times::Int=1)
    text = "Hello, $name! $(times + 1)\n"
    multi = """
        Multi $name
        """
    c = 'x'
    A = [1 2; 3 4]
    B = A' * A
    return repeat(text, times) * multi
end

@time result = map(x -> x^2, collect(1:10))
values = Dict("a" => 1, "b" => 2.5e3)
push!(values, "c" => 0x1F)
z = 3 + 2im
println(greet("world", 2), sum(result), z, nothing === nothing, true && !false)

end
